request.description: Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:roles.manage and a reason. Persisted wildcard permissions are rejected; the mutation and its audit record commit atomically.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:roles.manage, the current optimistic version, and a reason. The mutation and its audit record commit atomically.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:audit.view. Results are paginated explicit redacted projections; no token or audit content is stored in this collection.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:audit.view. Replace the synthetic ID only in an isolated non-production environment.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:users.view. Results are paginated safe account projections; no bearer token is stored in this collection.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:users.view. Use only an isolated synthetic non-Admin account; no bearer token is stored in this collection.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:providers.view. Results exclude private document delivery data; no bearer token is stored in this collection.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:providers.view. Document metadata excludes storage keys and permanent URLs; no bearer token is stored in this collection.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:users.manage. Use only an isolated synthetic non-Admin account. The reason is mandatory; no bearer token is stored in this collection.

Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:providers.review. providerId is the Provider application ID. Verification means manual platform approval only and makes no government or legal verification claim.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:locations.view. Filters, sorting, and pagination are bounded and allowlisted.
Requires a transient verified Admin bearer token with admin:locations.manage. Uses synthetic values only; localized content, stable slug, and reason are required.
Requires admin:locations.manage, a transient bearer token, current optimistic version, and reason. Replace the ID only in isolated non-production data.
Requires admin:locations.manage. Deletion fails closed for child-neighborhood or Provider references and is intended only for isolated synthetic data.
Requires admin:taxonomy.view and a transient bearer token.
Requires admin:taxonomy.manage; synthetic data only.
Requires admin:taxonomy.manage and current version.
Fails closed while referenced; isolated synthetic data only.
Requires an isolated verified provider session and a safe JPEG/PNG/floor-plan fixture.
Returns only authenticated provider-owned properties with bounded filters, deterministic ordering, pagination metadata, and state-derived availableActions.
Requires an isolated verified provider session. Provider ownership is checked against the bearer subject.
Returns only the authenticated provider-owned property.

Requires the current optimistic version; set step to basic, location, details, price-payment, features-services, or contact. Location writes also require an existing active location. Contact data contains no provider identity override or secrets.
Aggregate validation returns structured field errors; only a valid owned draft can enter pending_review.
Requires an authorized verified admin and a mandatory reason.
Hide, restore, or archive operations require an authorized verified admin and a mandatory reason.
Requires admin:properties.view. Filters are bounded and results are paginated with safe state-derived actions.
Requires admin:properties.review. Returns deterministic signals and human-readable explanations only; no AI matching or unverifiable score.
Requires admin:property-reports.view. Reporter identity is included only for administrators with manage permission.
Requires admin:property-reports.manage and the current optimistic version.
Requires admin:account-reports.view. Reporter identity is included only for administrators with manage permission.
Requires admin:account-reports.manage and the current optimistic version.
Requires a verified seeker, provider, or administrator token. Replays of the same reason are deduplicated.
Owner-scoped provider advertising projection. The API returns no provider, storage, or administrative internals.
Creates a provider-owned draft. Placement activation, request ownership, and validation are enforced by the API; no price is fabricated.
Owner-scoped provider advertising detail. Cross-provider or missing requests return the same not-found boundary.
A verified provider may accept only the quote attached to its own advertising request; acceptance advances the request to payment review and is not bank verification.
Streams a private provider-owned proof. The response exposes only redacted metadata; upload is not bank verification.
Reads the verified provider's effective commission policy as a read-only projection. The API returns source none when no approved active commission exists; no universal value is fabricated.
Requires a verified administrator with the ads view permission. Returns only the bounded administrative request and latest quote projection.
Requires a verified administrator with the ads view permission and excludes private payment-proof storage details.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:payments.review. Returns active payment-proof metadata for manual review without storage keys, permanent URLs, or bank-verification claims.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:payments.review. Approval or rejection is manual, reasoned, version-checked, and never bank verification.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:ads.view. Calendar events use deterministic Africa/Cairo local projections and bounded pagination.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:ads.schedule. Scheduling is version-checked, rejects placement overlaps, and returns a Cairo calendar projection.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:ads.view. Returns safe quote, payment-proof state, and schedule projections without bank verification or realized-revenue claims.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:ads.view and returns one safe financial review projection without private storage or internal audit data.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:ads.view. Ledger entries identify quote, payment-proof, or schedule source and remain accountingTreatment not_realized.
Requires a verified administrator with the pricing permission. The quote is manually issued in integer minor units with a future expiry; no universal advertising price is used.
Returns active localized category metadata without authentication.
Returns published articles only, with a safe category projection.
Returns one published article in an active category.

Requires a verified administrator with admin:commissions.view. Returns account_override, policy, or none with no universal commission or internal metadata.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:commissions.manage. Creates a draft override with strict value and effective-window validation; no settlement or universal-rate claim is made.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:commissions.view. Exception rows retain their required reasons and contain no storage internals or settlement claims.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:commissions.manage. Creates a draft exception with a required reason; no bank verification, settlement, or universal commission is implied.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:commissions.view. Returns acknowledgement state and policy version only; no private documents, storage keys, or settlement claims are exposed.
Requires a verified administrator with admin:commissions.view. Returns redacted before/after commission audit projections with actor, reason, request, trace, and effective-date metadata.
